description: Called by the address panel when the user clicks Optimize. Records the chosen addresses and route settings and returns the single-use confirmationToken that create_route takes. Not for direct model use.

endPlaceId.description: Omit to return to the start location.

ignoredFields.description: Unsupported input fields excluded from optimization, listed in the result.

startTime.description: Departure date/time with UTC offset; null when unspecified. Does not change traffic estimates.

stopPlaceIds.description: Unordered delivery locations returned by search_places. Array position does not constrain visit order; the optimizer reorders these stops.

name: confirm_route
title: Confirm reviewed route
